name: Arcy Julietta
original_name: アーシー・ジュリエッタ
source:
Arcy is an individual of great renown due to her extraordinary ability to predict the future. She has an enthusiasm for delicious candy and travels around the world in search of the legendary "candy maze." If met and given a piece of candy, she will predict one's future with 100% accuracy.

[From [url=http://alicesoft.wikia.com/wiki/Earthy_Jiuletta]AliceSoft Wiki[/url]]
